lines:
The opt-in project-local canonical history backend stores immutable bounded parent-linked JSONL segments, session branch metadata, frozen workflow/provenance records, and permitted content-addressed artifacts. It uses project-relative references and represents concurrent continuation from a common checkpoint as explicit branches.

It never stores credential values, inherited approvals, hidden reasoning, executable plugin code, or implicit authority. Import is inert and requires local capability rebinding. A Chat using this backend is not also canonical in SQLite; any local SQLite projection is disposable. Aworkit does not automatically commit or push portable files.

data.name: Portable Session Repository
data.technology: Immutable JSONL segments and content-addressed files in the selected project
